name: Mark Hudak
short_bio: Mark Hudak is a potter and the co-owner of Throwing Mud Gallery in Tacoma, making functional ceramics for daily use.

sources.label: Tacoma Arts Month: Tacoma Studio Tour 2026 artist map

biography: Mark Hudak is a potter and co-owner of Throwing Mud Gallery, the Tacoma gallery and pottery studio he opened with Eileen Hudak in 2011. He came to pottery through a required college class and was hooked at the wheel.

He moved to Tacoma from Chicago in 1977 to teach, and pottery became his full-time work. He makes functional pieces meant to be used, first selling at Northwest fairs and galleries and now from the shop.
